response.sql: WITH per_mgr AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country) SELECT player_id, death_country, award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM per_mgr ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST, player_id LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Share = the manager's award count divided by the total awards of all matched managers with the same death_country. Managers with NULL death_country are excluded before the totals are computed.
player_id is unique in player, so the join does not duplicate awards.
Ties in share are broken by player_id, which the request does not specify.
